Recurring Sales Invoice

Create sales invoices that repeat on a regular schedule.

Ideal for subscription services, maintenance contracts, or regular billing.

Next issue date

The date when the next sales invoice will be automatically created. This date advances automatically based on your frequency settings.

The system checks daily for recurring transactions due to be created. Set this to today or earlier to create the first invoice immediately.

DueDateDays

The payment terms in days. The due date for each generated invoice will be calculated as the issue date plus this number of days.

For example, enter 30 for Net 30 payment terms, or 7 for payment due within one week.

Interval

The frequency interval for creating invoices. This number works with the period type to set your billing cycle.

Common examples: 1 Month = monthly billing, 3 Months = quarterly billing, 1 Week = weekly billing, 1 Year = annual billing.

PeriodType

The period type that works with the interval to determine frequency. Select the unit of time for your billing cycle.

Most businesses use 'Months' for regular billing cycles. Use 'Days' for very frequent billing or 'Years' for annual contracts.

MonthDay

For monthly recurring invoices, specify which day of the month the invoice should be created.

Choose 'Same day each month' to maintain the original day, or select a specific day (1st, 15th, Last day, etc.) for consistent monthly billing.

ExpirationType

Determines when the recurring schedule ends. This controls how long the system will continue creating invoices.

Choose 'Until further notice' for indefinite subscriptions, or 'Until date' for contracts with a specific end date.

UntilDate

The date when recurring invoices will stop being created. The system will not create any invoices after this date.

Use this for fixed-term contracts or subscriptions with a known end date. Leave blank for ongoing services.

Customer

Select the customer who will receive these recurring invoices. Each generated invoice will be linked to this customer.

The customer's current billing address, credit terms, and other settings will be applied to each new invoice.

Billing address

The billing address for the customer. This address will appear on each generated invoice.

This field auto-fills from the customer record but can be customized for this recurring series if needed.

Description

A description that identifies what you're billing for. This appears on each generated invoice.

Be specific to help customers understand the charges. Examples: 'Monthly Website Hosting', 'Quarterly Maintenance Service', 'Annual Software License'.

Lines

The invoice lines specifying what you're charging for. These exact lines will appear on every generated invoice.

Add lines for each product or service in your recurring billing. You can use inventory items, service items, or direct account postings.

Prices and tax codes set here will be used for all future invoices unless you edit this template.

Automatic reference

When enabled, the system automatically assigns sequential reference numbers to each generated invoice.

Recommended for most businesses to ensure unique invoice numbers. Disable only if you have a specific numbering system requirement.
